whatsappMessage:

Maine aapke sports business ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme cricket kits, sportswear, fitness equipment, aur direct WhatsApp order inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/sumitsharma

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Sumit and Sharma Sports team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke sports store (Sumit and Sharma Sports) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a digital sports catalog, gear categories, and direct WhatsApp inquiry for your customers in Kankarbagh, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact inventory aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
